notes.title: Final Update of "Jumping Cat" Thank for all you guys who supported us!
notes.notes:
We will update the Final Chapter of "Jumping CAT". Our beloved Cat Hero's adventure journey will come to an end, with new updates and specific content as follows:
1. Chapter 4 of the Final Chapter - Lava Pit
2. Adding new levels, mechanisms.
3. Fixing some known bugs

Next are a few words from the Developer, which could be considered as a summary of "Jumping CAT".
The development of "Jumping CAT" can be summarized as a challenging journey. Although the result was not satisfactory. However fortunately, I found two like-minded friends to form a team of three to work remotely to develop "Jumping CAT". During the game development process, we planned to perfect the game framework through iteration in a short time. However, due to factors such as working only after work and manpower shortage, the overall development progress was not as expected, and the project was delayed for two years before it could be completed. There were also many interesting ideas, such as flowers wrapping around the Cat hero and laughing like a cannon, or catching flying birds in the air to pass through levels, but they were not implemented in the final version.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43002136/86bf85bd4a9ce2339828ff997855a9d927b7ef10.jpg
Although "Jumping CAT" is not perfect, we really feel the support and encouragement of many friends. We are now full of confidence and motivation to continue developing the next game. We are grateful for the support of every player and hope to launch more excellent independent games in the future, bringing more joy and exciment to players. If you ask me what I feel most deeply, it would be tiredness. It feels like we have been on the road the whole time, and when it was finally completed, The main thought in my head is not "Yes, We finally did it!" but the feeling of "let's just get this over with". So, I am really grateful to every player who purchased the game to support us, and I especially thank Chuyu for helping us publish "Jumping CAT". We will continue to work hard and hope to bring new independent games to everyone soon. At least we are still on the road, at least we are now working full-time, and at least we are working together in the office, so we will see you again soon. We hope that everyone can continue to support our work in the future!

Gavin

notes.title: Jumping Cat officially Release now!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43002136/86267992718b13a52751de9b1f1c8bf9b9903cf3.png
SimpleTouch Indie Studio is an indie studio focusing on simple, fun games. It has been established for more than 3 years . The studio currently only has 2 games, "Plop" and "Jumping Cat". SimpleTouch studio actually started up as solo developer. An indie gamer, who started working on his own game in his spare time. 3 years later, 3 other like-minded friends have joined and that's how Simple Touch founded. 

As the second platform jumping game from SimpleTouch Studio,  is a classic platform jumping game with simple controls, collecting gold coins and Paw Gems to complete the level.

At the beining we were plan to building it as an extensionthe of our first game "Plop", making them as a series focus on easy to play, step-by-step we are putting our ideas into practice. With the experience with our fi rst game, the team wanted to make a breakthrough with the second game, adding some jumping, fighting movement and an equipment collecting features in the "Jumping Cat". However, the process of making an indie game independently is one of constant compromise. Being a small studios means that we don't have enough manpower and financial resources, which often limited the production of games. So the initial plan of  was changed again and again, and unfortunately, the collection of equipment and fighting features were also removed due to many reasons. Our music belongs to the free and commercially available version from Japan's 魔王魂(https://maou.audio/). Although the development process encountered various problems, in the end it was completed after all. The game production process is also a process of iteration and accumulation of experience . We have done our best as a small team . Hope you will like our "Jumping Cat"and wishlist our game.

It may be easy just to clear the levels in , but it will take some patience to collect all the coins. We hope to bring you a simple and pure joy with a simple yet fun little game.
